summary: Phase A+B multi-tenant WhatsApp credentials tested. Backend 6/6 NEW tests PASS for tenant_credentials resolver + admin endpoints. 35/36 regression PASS. CRITICAL frontend blocker found and FIXED: stray garbage tokens at end of /app/frontend/src/lib/i18n.js (lines 1285-1287: 's;', 'ions;', 's;') caused a ReferenceError that crashed the entire React app on every page load. After fix the app renders normally and login works.

minor.issue: Meta API returns 400 '(#100) Need permission on either WhatsApp Business Account or owner/shared business' on delete. Token has create permission but not delete on this WABA. Pre-existing — not a regression of Phase A+B refactor (CREATE/LIST work fine through tenant_credentials).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent — End of file had stray garbage tokens 's;', 'ions;', 's;' on lines 1285-1287 after the legitimate `export default translations;`. Caused ReferenceError 'ions is not defined' on bundle evaluation, crashing the whole app for every user (login, inbox, admin, wizard — all blank with red error overlay).

integration_issues.issue: page.goto('/admin/setup-wizard') after a successful login redirects to /login — auth session not yet hydrated by the time the route guard evaluates. SPA-internal click navigation works. Low-priority router/auth race.

backend: services.tenant_credentials.get_tenant_credentials(None) → returns env (token, phone, waba) — env fallback works
services.tenant_credentials.get_tenant_credentials(<admin tenant>) → returns non-None (tenant phone+waba; token falls back to env when wiped)
PUT /api/admin/whatsapp-account accepts whatsapp_business_account_id field — value persists and is returned by GET
GET /api/admin/templates returns 200 with templates list (uses tenant WABA + env token fallback)
POST /api/messages/send/{conv_id} returns 200 (whatsapp_sent path) using tenant phone_id + env token fallback
Regression test_templates.py: 11/12 PASS (1 fail = Meta-side delete permission, 1 pre-existing skip)
frontend: After i18n.js fix, app loads and renders inbox correctly (Catalan UI 'Safata', conversation list visible)
Login flow (admin@workshoppartsdesk.com / Admin123!) succeeds and lands on / (inbox)
No JS console errors after the fix

action_items: VERIFY: i18n.js was likely corrupted by an accidental partial paste. Code-review for similar stray tokens in other files. Add a CI lint step (eslint or simple `node -c`) to catch syntax errors before merge.
(LOW) Investigate Meta token permissions for template DELETE — the System User token in .env appears to lack `whatsapp_business_management` delete scope on the configured WABA.
(LOW) Auth/router race when loading deep routes like /admin/setup-wizard with a freshly-restored session — guard should wait for auth hydration before redirecting to /login.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG (FIXED): /app/frontend/src/lib/i18n.js had stray non-statement tokens after `export default translations;`. This crashed the bundle on every load. The file now ends cleanly.

OK: services/tenant_credentials.py is well-structured: clear precedence (tenant override → env fallback), graceful exception handling (returns env on any DB error), token decryption only when stored value is truthy. Good.
OK: routers/templates.py refactor — removed direct env reads, all paths go through _get_tenant_meta_creds which raises 400 with Catalan message when WABA missing. Consistent.

OK: services/whatsapp.py — send_whatsapp_message, send_whatsapp_template, send_whatsapp_document, upload_media_to_whatsapp all now accept tenant_id and resolve credentials via get_tenant_credentials. mark_message_as_read still uses the global env token directly — minor inconsistency but low impact.
OK: WAAccountUpdate Pydantic model now includes whatsapp_business_account_id; PUT correctly merges only non-None fields.
MINOR: SetupWizard.js Step 1 has both Phone ID and WABA ID inputs with proper data-testids and Next button correctly disabled until both are non-empty (verified via code review).
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/lib/i18n.js (removed stray garbage tokens at EOF — critical app-crash fix)
/app/backend/tests/test_tenant_credentials.py (NEW — 6 tests for tenant_credentials resolver + new endpoints)

Setup Wizard could not be exercised end-to-end via Playwright due to auth-hydration redirect, but code review confirms data-testids, both fields required, Meta link, System User tip+link, and Step 3 summary all match spec.

seed_data_creation: Test sent one TEST_phaseA outbound message via /api/messages/send (visible in conversation list as 'TEST_phaseA from automated test'). PUT whatsapp-account test is idempotent (sets WABA back to .env value 1479512030191419, same as DEV fallback).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_tenant_credentials.py /app/backend/tests/test_templates.py /app/backend/tests/test_case_notes.py /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_cases_api.py -v` for full Phase A+B + regression. Inputs: data-testid='wizard-phone-id' and 'wizard-waba-id'. Step 2 has data-testid='wizard-cert-input' (assumed). On Step 3 the summary text 'WABA ID' is rendered as a literal label.

rca_of_the_issue.i18n_crash: EOF garbage tokens (`s;`, `ions;`, `s;`) on lines 1285-1287 of /app/frontend/src/lib/i18n.js caused a runtime ReferenceError when the bundle executed. Likely caused by an accidental partial paste/replace operation. Symptom: every page in the app shows the red CRA error overlay 'ions is not defined' and white-screens. Mitigation: removed the 3 stray lines so file now ends with `export default translations;`. Repro: load any route (https://saas-automotive-hub.preview.emergentagent.com/login) before fix → red overlay; after fix → login UI renders normally.
